name: generate_image
description:
Generate an image from a text prompt; pass reference_images as an array of image paths for image-to-image.
Uses the configured OpenAI or RightCode image API. Each reference_images entry takes the same kind of reference vision_analyze accepts; on messaging platforms a reference must be attached to the current turn, listed in the chat history as context_image_N, or a trusted avatar URL. Returns the local path of the generated image. Delivery differs by host: follow the assistant_instruction field in the tool result — on messaging platforms the image is not delivered automatically and must be sent with send_message_to_user; in local sessions the host displays it automatically.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images for image-to-image. Each value takes the same forms as vision_analyze's image: a local image path, an http(s) image URL, or a context_image_N from the chat history.
